narrative.overview: A small, deliberate web studio that feels like quality stationery: a cream paper background, ink-dark typography, a single confident blue used the way a notary stamps a contract. Premium and practical at the same time. The visual world is the bay window of a craftsman's workshop, not the lobby of a software company. This system explicitly rejects the AI-generated SaaS landing page reflex: cream-and-purple gradients, identical icon card grids, repeated all-caps eyebrow pills above every heading, glassy translucent panels. It also rejects the editorial-magazine aesthetic (Fraunces italic, mono uppercase labels, three-column ruled grids), which would feel wrong to a roofer scrolling on a phone at 7 a.m. The studio is precise but not refined into preciousness.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper background, dark navy text, one signal blue used sparingly.
One typographic family (Geist) carries the entire system. Discipline of weight and size, not variety of family.
Two committed-navy 'drench' moments per page maximum. Used as voice, not wallpaper.
Each page has its own dominant layout shape. No two routes share the same composition.
Real component library, real reusable primitives, no per-section copy-paste.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue covers at most 10% of any page. Its rarity is the point. If a page reads as 'blue,' it has failed.

rules.name: The Two Drench Moments Rule
rules.body: Ink Navy as a section background appears at most twice on any page.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Pure #000 and pure #fff are forbidden as text colors. Every neutral is tinted toward cream or navy.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Geist carries the entire system. Distinction comes from weight and size, not from introducing a second family.

rules.name: The Quiet Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: All-caps tracked labels appear at most twice in the entire site. They are not section grammar.

rules.name: The Lead Paragraph Rule
rules.body: Below the Display headline on each page, exactly one lead paragraph at Body Lead size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows belong to the primary CTA and interactive cards only.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No colored shadows of any kind. Shadows are tinted with Ink Navy at low opacity.

dos: Do keep all-caps tracked labels (Label typography) to at most two appearances per page, and at most two pages in the entire site.
Do vary section layouts: split hero, comparison table, timeline, filter grid, accordion, drench band.
Do keep body copy width to 65ch on desktop and 58ch where reading rhythm matters.
Do put the primary CTA (Book Free Website Audit) in the same visual position on every page and the same color (Ink Navy pill).
Do tint every neutral toward cream or navy. Never use #000 or #fff as text.
Do label every concept example as 'Concept example,' visibly, twice.
Do show pricing on /packages above the fold on desktop, full table comparison below.
Do keep mobile CTAs to single-column, full-width, 14px+ tap padding.
donts: Don't put an all-caps blue eyebrow pill above every section heading.
Don't repeat the 'icon + heading + 2 lines, six cards in a grid' pattern.
Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, animated blobs, or floating particles.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px on cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't invent fake testimonials, fake client logos, fake metric badges, or AI-generated faces.
Don't put modals anywhere on this site.
Don't write the words: transform, unlock, seamless, innovative, cutting-edge, enterprise-grade, we leverage, world-class, best-in-class, industry-leading.
Don't use Inter, DM Sans, Plus Jakarta, Instrument, Plex, Outfit, or any other reflex-reject sans.
Don't add a second font family without a written reason in DESIGN.md.
Don't use blue as a background on a section larger than a small banner.
Don't animate width, height, padding, margin, top, left, or any other layout property.
